reason: Self-described "systematic review" of large multimodal agents with a taxonomy and an evaluation framework; secondary study.
Comprehensive literature review of embodied AI from LLMs to world models, with taxonomy and future directions; secondary study.
ADAS/Meta Agent Search: the agentic design itself (workflow, arrangement of modules) is the searched variable; compared against hand-designed agents and transfer-tested. Control topology.
Comparative review of LLMs in engineering; synthesises prior work, no method of its own.
TextGrad is a framework for optimising compound AI systems; reported claims are end-task outcomes (GPQA 51->55%, LeetCode, molecules, radiotherapy), not about the feedback loop.
Historical overview positing AI 1.0-4.0 generations; taxonomy-only, no loop-control mechanism studied.
Comprehensive survey of LLM self-evolution approaches with conceptual framework and taxonomy; secondary study.
Self-Discover composes reasoning modules into a structure followed during decoding; no feedback returns control, results are benchmark accuracy.
Systematic review of feedback mechanisms in LLM agents, categorising four feedback types; secondary study.
Position paper: need-driven regulators feed a softmax control system for action selection plus a Protect layer that overrides unsafe behaviour, argued with falsifiable predictions. Iteration policy.
Iterative prompt refinement for gene-relation extraction from ChatGPT; prompt engineering evaluated by F1/precision/recall, no runtime agent loop.
rStar-Math's innovations are data synthesis, PRM training and a self-evolution training recipe; claims are MATH/AIME accuracy, not about the search loop.
Abstract is bibliographic only; title names reflection-driven self-improvement as the contribution, i.e. a refinement cycle. Retry/repair.
Gome contrasts gradient-style directed updates against tree search as the MLE agent's search regime, with a crossover measured across 10 models under a closed-world protocol. Iteration policy.
CSTS builds a skill tree and training data, then trains OpenClaw-Skill; claims are agentic benchmark performance, not evidence about the search mechanism.
TreeThink is a library integrating established tree search methods; claims are miniF2F/MATH500 results and an implementation speedup, not a new loop-control mechanism.
MCTS with a residual energy function acting as path verifier to rank and select reasoning steps at inference, measured against the fine-tuned model. Iteration policy/verification.
RTSoG: training-free Self-Critic MCTS with reward guidance iteratively retrieves and weights reasoning paths, compared to alternative path-retrieval strategies. Iteration policy.
PGTS learns a policy that decides expand, branch, backtrack or terminate, replacing hand-set heuristics, with cost reductions reported. Iteration policy and termination.
AutoTool is an SFT+RL training pipeline plus a 200k dataset for tool selection; claims are benchmark gains across ten tasks.
TabTracer enforces step-level verification with typed checks and versioned-snapshot rollback under budget-aware pruning, reporting 59-84% token reduction. Verification and retry/repair.
Tempest branches conversations breadth-first across turns, re-injecting partial compliance, and is compared to Crescendo/GOAT on queries used. Iteration policy.
LELMA validates reasoning by autoformalisation and a solver, reporting error-detection accuracy and the effect of self-refinement on correctness. Verification.
MEDAL searches unmasking trajectories during diffusion LM decoding; the loop is token generation, not a language-model agent's control loop.
JARVIS is a neuro-symbolic embodied agent framework; reported claims are TEACh success rates (EDH 6.1->15.8%).
An agent produces task instructions for zero-shot reasoning; no feedback returns control, and claims are accuracy on 29 datasets.
Studies autonomous vs program-driven tree search in LLMs, comparing ATS-BFS to CoT and Tree-of-Thoughts on accuracy and API cost. Iteration policy.
MZQA makes MCTS over reasoning paths the zero-shot control procedure and measures the search/behavioural-cloning trade-off (10x speed, small loss). Iteration policy.
GATS pits UCB1 tree search with a layered world model against LATS and ReAct, measuring success, LLM calls per task (0 vs 37) and plan variance. Iteration policy.
ARTS decouples proposal from decision, repurposing the verifier via flow matching, and shows recovery on the long tail where coupled RL collapses. Verification.
Multi-agent debate framework whose reported claims are accuracy gains on MMMU/MMBench/MVBench across VLM backbones; a system result.
Tree-GRPO is an RL training algorithm using tree-structured rollouts for advantage estimation; claims are QA task performance over 11 datasets.
Stage-MCTS uses search to generate training data for SFT plus a new dataset; claims are text-to-NoSQL execution-match accuracy.
Applies off-the-shelf Language Agent Tree Search to microservice root cause analysis; claims are diagnostic accuracy (91.3% benchmark, 65.1% production).
MCTS is used to generate process supervision data for iterative training; claims are accuracy on two math datasets.
VerifiAgent's meta-verification and adaptive tool-based verification are compared head-to-head with deductive and backward verifiers and with process reward models. Verification.
SC-MCTS* ablates MCTS components, rebuilds the reward model, and revises UCT selection and backpropagation, reporting per-node speed and component effects. Iteration policy.
FETCH diagnoses over- and under-exploration in verifier-guided tree search, merges equivalent states and reduces verifier variance, tested across four search algorithms. Iteration policy.
Empirical-MCTS carries experience across problems via evolving meta-prompts and a memory agent to steer later search, compared against stateless MCTS. Loop state.
AgentMath is a tool-augmented agent plus RL training system; claims are AIME/HMMT accuracy and training throughput.
TOA evolves the multi-agent workflow by MCTS rather than fixing it, and compares multi-agent against single-agent orchestration as inference compute scales. Control topology.
Graph-O1 is an agentic GraphRAG system trained end-to-end with RL; claims are QA accuracy over baselines, not evidence about the loop.
TS-LLM systematically studies AlphaZero-style tree search with a learned value function guiding LLM decoding, across search depths up to 64 and task types. Iteration policy.
Read-Gate is a runtime invariant forcing a read after search before finalisation; failures are decomposed over 12,000 trajectories and the gate's effect measured. Termination.
M2A merges task vectors in parameter space; claims are SWE-Bench resolved rate (44.0->51.2%) and reasoning length, not loop control.
